# STM32H743 Nano FC + 4-in-1 ESC: Power, Thermal, and DShot Architecture (Job #13)

## 0. Scope and Assumptions

**Architectural split.** The STM32H743 runs ArduPilot and generates bidirectional DShot600. The 48 kHz PWM is generated by four ESC MCUs (for example AT32F421 or STM32G071 running AM32) driving the bridges. The H743 never switches the FETs. This separates the electrical model into two domains:

| Domain | Owner | Key numbers |
|---|---|---|
| Power stage | ESC MCU (AM32), gate driver, 24 MOSFETs | 80 A burst per channel, 48 kHz, 6S |
| Control link | STM32H743 timers and DMA | DShot600, bidirectional eRPM telemetry |

**Reference MOSFET.** No part was specified, so I use a representative 40 V, 3.3×3.3 mm DFN device. Substitute your datasheet values. Every equation below is parametric.

| Parameter | Symbol | Value |
|---|---|---|
| R_DS(on) @ 25 °C, V_GS = 10 V | R₂₅ | 1.0 mΩ |
| Temperature coefficient (linearized) | α | 0.0045 /K |
| Total gate charge | Q_g | 60 nC |
| Gate-source charge above V_th | Q_gs2 | 8 nC |
| Miller charge | Q_gd | 10 nC |
| Plateau voltage | V_pl | 3.5 V |
| Threshold voltage | V_th | 2.5 V |
| Internal gate resistance | R_g,int | 1.0 Ω |
| Energy-related output capacitance | C_o(er) | 1.5 nF |
| Body-diode reverse recovery charge | Q_rr | 40 nC |
| Body-diode forward voltage | V_F | 0.8 V |
| Junction-to-case (pad) thermal resistance | R_θJC | 1.5 K/W |

**Operating point.**

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Bus voltage | V_bus = 25.2 V (6S fully charged, worst case for switching loss) |
| Phase current during conduction | I = 80 A (burst) |
| Switching frequency | f_sw = 48 kHz |
| Gate driver | V_DRV = 10 V; R_src = 5 Ω, R_snk = 2.5 Ω (FD6288-class) |
| Dead time | t_dt = 100 ns |
| Commutation | 6-step trapezoidal, complementary (synchronous) PWM |
